correctness.rationale: For any even k, the two-dissection identity for F^2 gives A_2(4n+3) divisible by 8 and all odd coefficients of F^2 even. The formal Frobenius congruence F^(2^e) ≡ F(q^2)^(2^(e-1)) modulo 2^e yields the claimed lower bounds for k divisible by 4, k ≡2 modulo 4 and k ≡2 modulo 8. The exact initial coefficient k(k+1)(k+14)/6 attains all bounds except k ≡2 modulo 16; there the independently derived F^16 truncation and A_2(7)=328 give A_(16m+2)(7) ≡8 modulo16 for every nonnegative m. The checker reconstructs F from both marked-part products and eta products, verifies all low-degree identities and tests 80 even k and 24 progression indices. The finite tests are not used as proof of infinitely many coefficient assertions.

originality.rationale: Conjecture 6.1 of Yaqubi–Mirzavaziri (arXiv:2611.05623v1, Section 6) explicitly leaves the exact 2-adic all-n bound open, notably the exceptional even parameters k ≡2 modulo16. Theorem 3.12 establishes lower bounds and Proposition 3.13 one sharp even subfamily; neither implies the exact second-witness congruence A_(16m+2)(7) ≡8 modulo16. The claim covers all even parameters and has only 3/7 sharpness witnesses. The earlier odd-parameter result is deliberately not claimed again. Actual comparisons found no stronger covering theorem, though lack of indexed matches is not proof of uniqueness.
residual_risks: A new unindexed post-November-3 proof or an alternative general all-k theorem could cover this exact statement.

value.rationale: This fills the even-parameter half of an explicitly stated 2026 classification conjecture for a canonical number-theoretic partition family. Beyond the valuation list it shows that the 2-adic gcd over an infinite arithmetic progression always has an exact witness at weight 3 or 7, and that the sharp exceptional k ≡2 modulo16 boundary forces using the latter. The goal is a natural complete classification and small-witness principle, not a routine recomputation or an unsupported global significance claim; odd-prime gcds and termwise valuations remain open.
